sources.title: Ten things we know to be true

concepts.name: 通用工作台
concepts.description: 稳定导航、自由画布、直接操作和实时语音；适合作为默认界面。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 1 — GENERAL WORKBENCH, THE RECOMMENDED DEFAULT.
Screen shows a practical project "产品发布". A slim 80px-wide stable left navigation rail has four readable destinations with simple material icons: "画布" selected, "素材", "任务", "历史"; settings at the bottom. A restrained top app bar shows norma, project name, a compact "+ 添加" button, "整理" action, Undo and Redo, and a simple 100% zoom menu. The rest is an expansive black 2D infinite canvas; no chat sidebar by default.
On the canvas are THREE useful heterogeneous live content objects aligned in a deliberately efficient arrangement: a large website preview on the left showing a minimal product webpage with title "让想法成为作品", a refined small device/product photograph and clear navigation; a video node on the right playing a software product demonstration with a small playback scrubber; below those an open PDF/file node titled "发布清单.pdf" displaying a few legible checklist rows and owner labels. The selected video has a thin soft-blue outline, drag handles, a readable "已选中" chip, and a local contextual action capsule "全屏 · 固定 · 更多". Other content objects have neutral edges and short title bars that identify their type.
A compact floating voice-session dock occupies otherwise empty canvas space in the lower-left next to the rail, with a tiny three-stroke audio indicator, "实时对话", heard phrase "把网页和视频并排，文件放下面", a Stop square button and small keyboard icon. A separate modest Material snackbar near lower center reads "已整理 3 项内容" with clearly clickable "撤销". Keep this separate from the live voice status. Scene must make the voice action's selected target and actual arranged result unambiguous. Professional, useful, immediately understandable.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE production-plausible high fidelity desktop screenshot for Norma, a real-time conversational workspace for manipulating a canvas of webpages, documents, images, videos, notes and live terminals. The goal is PRACTICAL EVERYDAY UTILITY. This is an active application with a specific user task, not a landing page, abstract sci-fi installation, or decorative assistant mascot.
Art direction: Google / Material Design 3 design philosophy applied thoughtfully to Norma. User-goal first, stable familiar navigation, consistent alignment, visibly discoverable commands, tonal surface hierarchy, clear selection and status. Confident systematic desktop design. Wide 16:10 landscape flat app screenshot, no device frame or external presentation border, crisp native-like rendering.
Use a deep near-black workspace background (#0C0F14), graphite tonal surfaces (#171B22 and #202630), readable off-white text, soft desaturated blue primary accents (#A8C7FA), restrained semantic green for completed states. Roboto/Google Sans-like typography with high-quality Chinese sans-serif. Consistent 8px spacing rhythm, modest purposeful corner radii, thin dividers, flat accessible surfaces. Optical glass is limited to the small floating voice control, not every component. Real white documents and light webpages keep their own natural background. No heavy drop shadows, no luminous borders except subtle blue selection.
Every major actionable control should look like an understandable button, not a mysterious futuristic symbol. Keep text to short crisp labels. Make active selection clear with both an outline and a selected label or handles. Show Undo and a simple Stop voice button where appropriate. Voice status must explicitly say "实时对话"; use an active microphone or sound icon, NEVER a crossed-out microphone alongside active listening. Show a compact readable live command and a short action confirmation with "撤销"; voice has an optional keyboard input affordance. AI is an unobtrusive assistant integrated with the task, no central orb and no giant greeting.
Screen should feel calm and spacious while the current content occupies the majority of usable area. Show realistic useful details rather than empty content rectangles. Do NOT show Google branding, the Google logo, a four-color Google mascot, Gmail, or label the product Gemini. Brand is "norma". Not a dashboard full of widgets; avoid pseudo telemetry, decorative node connectors, space stars, angled 3D windows, HUD graphics, big marketing headlines, neon cyan frames, endless controls, or unreadable tiny dummy text.

concepts.name: 资料研究台
concepts.description: 素材、阅读、对话各有位置，生成结论时能追溯来源。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 2 — SOURCE-GROUNDED RESEARCH, THREE PANE READING WORKFLOW.
A practical Google-inspired research workspace titled "竞品调研". This is NOT a freeform collage. A 240px left sources pane with heading "资料", a small search input, "+ 添加资料", and four short file/link rows with checkboxes and clear type icons: "竞品 A 网页", "竞品 B 网页", "定价说明.pdf", "演示视频.mp4". Selected sources are explicitly checked. At the bottom a small "4 项资料" label.
The large central reading/authoring pane shows one readable clean white report titled "产品对比摘要", a brief introduction, a simple three-row comparison table with columns "功能", "产品 A", "产品 B", two restrained light blue inline source markers [1] [2], and a short section "建议". Top of this pane has tabs "摘要" and "画布", small Undo control and a document expand/fullscreen control. Sources cited in the report correspond visibly to the left rows.
A 310px right assistant pane headed "Norma" with a small "实时对话" state and sound glyph. Only two short conversational turns, not a wall of chat: heard request "对比价格和功能，标明来源"; assistant reply "已整理对比摘要，可查看原文。" Beneath the reply are two useful action chips "查看来源" and "放到画布". At the bottom of this assistant pane is a compact active voice control with Stop and a keyboard alternative.
The app has a single quiet top bar with project breadcrumb and share button. Tinted dark chrome and soft blue controls surrounding high-legibility white content. A modest confirmation "摘要已更新 · 撤销" near the report bottom. The user can read, trace evidence, talk and transfer the output to the larger canvas without hunting for hidden controls. No giant images, no glowing assistant sculpture.

concepts.name: 并排对比
concepts.description: 让网页、文档或视频占据主屏，语音直接切换与比较。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 3 — FOCUSED COMPARISON, TWO EQUAL LARGE CONTENT PANES.
A beautifully practical full-width side-by-side comparison workspace, header "方案对比", no permanent sources sidebar and no permanent chat column. Top-left clearly visible "返回画布". A quiet top toolbar shows "替换内容", a visible toggle "同步滚动" switched on, Undo, and zoom controls; current comparison target is evident.
Two nearly equally wide content panes occupy about 75% of the screen. The left is a live webpage titled "方案 A · 网页", showing a restrained project proposal with a large but not oversized interior/reference image and a short three-row feature/cost summary. The right is a PDF titled "方案 B · PDF", with an analogous proposal image, a readable price line, and a three-row feature/cost summary. Give the panes small neutral title bars with open-source and fullscreen icons. The two documents display actual meaningful differences: left "预算 ¥48,000" and right "预算 ¥56,000"; one right-hand feature row has a soft amber highlight and a clear "不同" label. Do not make the entire pane border glow.
A single shallow lower findings region uses 2 concise useful chips "预算 +¥8,000" and "增加隔音处理"; enough black margin around them. Lower-left a compact small voice control with active sound icon and "实时对话", heard phrase "并排打开两个方案，标出差异", Stop control and keyboard input affordance. Lower-right a restrained snackbar "已标出 2 处差异" plus blue text "撤销". Plain stable composition, useful readable comparison, strong Google-style clarity. No decorative node connections, no rotated panes, no tall task dashboard.

concepts.name: 内容编辑台
concepts.description: 语音和鼠标共同编辑，选中对象后显示对应工具。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 4 — COMPOSING CONTENT WITH DIRECT MANIPULATION AND CONTEXTUAL TOOLS.
A realistic visual canvas editor for a presentation titled "项目介绍". Google Slides / Material clarity interpreted originally for Norma, no copied branding. Quiet top bar: project breadcrumb, Undo/Redo, "+ 插入", "排列", and one soft blue "导出" button. A narrow left layers/content pane labelled "内容" contains FIVE useful short rows with small type icons: "标题", "图片 1", "图片 2", "图片 3", "视频"; the three image rows are simultaneously selected with tonal blue backgrounds and checkbox indicators.
Center is a spacious graphite workspace containing one nearly front-facing white presentation/artboard labelled "第 1 页". The authored content is beautiful but very simple: heading "设计，让生活更简单"; THREE photographic images now perfectly aligned in one horizontal row with equal widths and equal spacing, showing a calm desktop, product detail, and daylight interior; one shared visible selection bounding box with blue handles around the three images. Below them one modest integrated video placeholder/frame with a play icon and caption "产品演示". A short contextual toolbar directly above the selected images offers meaningful "对齐", "等距", "分组". No unexplained controls.
The narrow right inspector ONLY shows image-relevant controls, heading "3 张图片", simple size fields, alignment icons and spacing "24"; no wall of advanced properties.
Bottom-left of the workspace a compact active voice dock says "实时对话" and "把三张图等宽排列，间距一致", with Stop and keyboard icons. A brief Material snackbar "已等距排列 3 张图片" plus "撤销". Show a clean practical edit state where the speech result can immediately be refined by mouse. No desktop collage, no large assistant avatar, very legible hierarchy.

concepts.name: 任务执行台
concepts.description: 实时对话同时查看网页预览、终端与任务进度。
concepts.detail:
CONCEPT 5 — EXECUTION WORKSPACE FOR NORMA'S CODING-AGENT USE CASE.
A highly usable voice-operated project workspace titled "Norma 官网". Narrow stable left rail with "画布", "任务" selected, "文件", "历史". Top bar has project name, task label "修复页面布局", Undo and "+ 添加".
The main central-left area, roughly 65% of width, is a LARGE live webpage preview with a modest browser-like title bar "网站预览 · localhost:3000", reload, and fullscreen buttons. Inside is a tasteful clean light actual product website, with readable heading "把想法交给 Norma", concise copy, a restrained product UI image, and one action button. This is visible functioning output, not a poster or wireframe.
Right-side contextual column, roughly 27% of width, has TWO vertically arranged practical regions. Upper: task checklist heading "执行进度", clearly enumerated states "检查页面" completed with a check and label "完成"; "修复布局" completed; "验证功能" actively running with a small progress indicator and explicit "进行中". A visible "暂停任务" button belongs here. Lower: compact live terminal pane titled "终端", simple monospace legible lines "Preview ready", "Checking layout…", "Running checks…", and a blinking cursor, not dense code or hundreds of fabricated logs. Content and status are clearly different regions.
In open black space below the central preview a compact active voice session shows sound glyph, "实时对话", heard phrase "打开预览，修复布局，告诉我进度", and one Stop voice button distinct from Pause task. A short assistant status line "布局已修复，正在验证" links speech to progress; a small reversible notification "预览已打开 · 撤销" is secondary. Show practical overview and ability to stop the current operation. Familiar Material tonal panels and purposeful simple controls; no fake futuristic gauges, no giant orb, no illustrations covering the working results.

refinements.prompt:
